import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    chars = list(line)
    result = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(chars)
    while i < n:
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and chars[j] == chars[i]:
            j += 1
        if ((j - i) & 1) == 0:
            result += 1
        i = j
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
